summary:
Implemented the rich_measure/VerticalCenter feature by editing files only; nothing was committed and no tests or repository code were run.

Changes:
- rich/tree.py: added Tree.__rich_measure__ (iterative, explicit stack of iterators, level counter, 4 cells of indent per level, unchanged max_width passed to labels) and imported Measurement.
- rich/align.py: Align.__rich_console__ now constrains the wrapped renderable to its measured maximum (min with explicit width if given); added Align.__repr__; added public VerticalCenter class (render with pad=False, height from console.size.height, newline-only padding, __rich_measure__ delegating to the wrapped renderable, __repr__).
- rich/console.py: Console.print renders collected renderables with self.options.update(justify="default"); justify still passed into _collect_renderables.
- CHANGELOG.md: 9.8.0 heading marked "- Unreleased", added "### Added" with the two entries; existing entry kept.
- tests/test_align.py: imports VerticalCenter; added test_repr, test_vertical_center_render, test_vertical_center_measure, test_vertical_center_no_padding_when_tall.
- tests/test_tree.py: imports Measurement; added test_measure expecting Measurement(11, 19) for the acceptance tree.

Choices: "unreleased" written as "- Unreleased" in the heading; the Tree level counter can reach -1 after the root iterator is exhausted, which is harmless. Tests were not run, so all results are verified by reading only.
